description: The current value of one official figure by key — a tax threshold, rate, allowance, fee, deadline, limit or policy rate — with the date it was verified, the official source URL, the period it applies to and a signature. Keys are `<country>/<topic>/<fact>`, e.g. `uk/income-tax/personal-allowance`, `uk/national-insurance/primary-threshold`, `us/social-security/wage-base`, `de/income-tax/grundfreibetrag`, `uk/bank-rate`, `eu/ecb/deposit-facility`, `uk/gov/passport-renewal-adult/fee-online-uk`. A loose key is resolved when unambiguous; otherwise the answer lists candidate keys. `max_age` (e.g. `30d`) marks the answer `stale` when the verification is older than that. Several keys separated by commas return a batch. Covers UK, US and German rates and thresholds, UK vehicle tax and MOT rules, UK government service fees, UK exam dates and central-bank policy rates; `coverage` lists the rest.

as_of.description: optional YYYY-MM-DD: the value in force that day

key.description: one key, or several separated by commas (max 50), e.g. uk/income-tax/personal-allowance

period.description: optional period label instead of as_of, e.g. 2025-26

name: get_fact
title: Get a verified fact
